RoomsExperiencesVisitStay guideAsk about dates

Before you pack your bag.

Arrival times, room requests, and the practical details to plan before your stay.

Anything else to plan?

Ask your question with the dates and room you have in mind. We can discuss the details before you decide.

Ask a questionLocation & arrival
When can I check in and out?

Check-in starts at 14:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Ask about an early arrival or late departure when you enquire; the team will confirm what is available for your dates.

Can I bring children?

Include each child’s age and your preferred sleeping arrangements in your enquiry. We will confirm the suitable room and any extra bed arrangements before you book.

How do I check room accessibility?

Tell us about any step-free access, bathroom, or mobility requirements. Ask for room and access details before deciding so you can choose a stay that suits your needs.

Is breakfast included?

Breakfast inclusion is confirmed with your room rate. Share dietary needs and early departure plans so the breakfast arrangements can be agreed before arrival.

Can you help with the journey?

Share where you are travelling from and when you expect to arrive. The team can discuss directions and transport arrangements with you.

What if my plans change?

Contact the hotel with your booking details and preferred change. Your confirmation contains the cancellation and date-change terms agreed for your stay.
